name: Pax
identity_check: Confirmed as pax.vc (Pax Ventures / Pax VC), the San Francisco firm founded by Michelle Volz, formerly of Andreessen Horowitz's American Dynamism team, which announced a $50M Fund I in March 2026; its site lists Nominal, Mariana Minerals and Method Security as portfolio. Not Pax, the Brazilian public-safety AI company (Greenoaks/Benchmark-led seed), not Pax Labs, not Pax Technology. The 'PAX Venture Capital' named in Nominal's Series B post is treated as this firm because pax.vc lists Nominal; no page states the name equivalence, so it is flagged. No evidence of any other firm called PAX Venture Capital was found.

open_items: Pax's own role as lead in any round was not found; all three recorded rounds name Pax as a participant or in an unlabelled investor list.
pax.vc and the founder's post state no stages or check size; those come from a podcast-style digest (TBPN) of the founder's own words. The Newcomer and PEI articles were paywalled or sparse.
Fund close date 2026-03-09 is the announcement date (founder's post, Newcomer, TBPN); PEI dates its article 2026-03-10.

Portfolio rounds not confirmed on a fetched page naming Pax: Northwood Space Series B (Law360 excerpt does not name Pax), Aalo Atomics Series B (search results do not name Pax), and others on the 26-company portfolio list.
